headline: 13 contracts catalogued (Ethereum and Avalanche; 0 on Plume); 4 vault tokens from official docs, 9 proxy/beacon/constructor-arg addresses from Etherscan.

findings.text: Etherscan token page for SIERRA (0xBcEb…1aD3) was fetched. It shows an EIP-1967 BeaconProxy, implementation 0xfd10892c…7833, beacon 0x18591617…61Fb, and 8 unlabeled constructor/initializer address arguments. Direct explorer fetch of snowscan for the Avalanche token failed. Plume explorer search returned no Sierra-tagged page.

Official docs page docs.sierra.money/building-with-sierra/blockchain-addresses lists 4 token addresses: SIERRA (Ethereum), SPLUS (Ethereum), SIERRA (Avalanche) and SIERRA OFT (Ethereum). It lists no Plume address, no timelock, and no multisig.

The pinned Cantina report (LytPool, 24-29 Aug 2025, commissioned by OpenTrade) was fetched. It contains no in-scope address table. The docs also reference a second Cantina report (Oct 2026) as a file attachment, which was not fetched.
No GitHub repo is pinned. The Cantina report links to the upstream OpenTrade repo github.com/opentrade-io/LytPool, which was not walked. No deployment artifacts were retrieved.
Ethereum has 5 addresses surfaced from Etherscan, plus 4 token addresses from docs. Avalanche has 1 address (docs only). Plume Mainnet has zero addresses surfaced.

No factory address was confirmed. The Etherscan source file list for the SIERRA token shows LYTPoolFactory-style source files, but no address for such a factory was fetched. The 8 initializer args may include some of these (unverified).

Roles assigned tentatively: the 4 documented vault tokens are 'token'; the beacon is 'proxy_admin (beacon)'; the implementation and the 8 constructor args are 'other', with actor_class unknown because bytecode was not read.
All admin_addresses entries trace to fetched pages (docs addresses page or Etherscan token page). Snippet-only sightings were kept out of admin_addresses and logged in unknowns.

rationale.verdict: Walked the website, the docs addresses and audit pages, the Cantina report, and the Etherscan page for the SIERRA token on Ethereum; catalogued 13 addresses, with the Plume chain and the control/treasury/timelock surface still undiscovered.

evidence.shows: Website fetched. Describes a permissionless RWA vault protocol with deposit/withdraw vaults and Liquid Vault Tokens (LayerZero OFT bridging, RedStone NAV oracle, Authorized Participants). Links to docs.sierra.money and the Contract Audits page.

Official addresses page. Lists SIERRA (Ethereum) 0xbceb5f6877d979ec621ae694da1102cb95691ad3, SPLUS (Ethereum) 0x7706b1a531A7A8cB4c26D24CDc9ae4094a3e0302, SIERRA (Avalanche) 0x6E6080e15f8C0010d333D8CAeEaD29292ADb78f7, and SIERRA OFT on Ethereum 0x6bf7788EAA948d9fFBA7E9bb386E2D3c9810e0fc.
Says Sierra is built on OpenTrade's LYT protocol, audited by Spearbit's Cantina in Aug 2025 (no High/Critical) and Oct 2026 (file attachment). Links to docs.opentrade.io/code-audits.

Cantina report 'LytPool' for OpenTrade, 24-29 Aug 2025. Names contracts (LYTPool, LYTPoolController, LYTPoolAccessControlFactory, LYTPoolServiceConfiguration, LYTPoolRegistry) and references github.com/opentrade-io/LytPool. Contains no address table.

SIERRA on Ethereum (0xBcEb5f6877d979EC621AE694dA1102CB95691aD3) is a verified BeaconProxy (EIP-1967) with implementation 0xfd10892c8A1CaC5b279ee22877DCC735DB7b7833. Constructor args decode to beacon 0x1859161792CEE3a4937f504E288a548F5c8a61Fb plus 8 unlabeled address args (0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, 0xad795e380725d85e0c62da50b91126a12043922a, 0xf6066092c79b39f0dffa7b22f64c0aa00071da03, 0x0bf2f23deaac37a5350c5e8e17445f77c6097989, 0x19e024b9c4f67e3185994c27905834f12bf1b8a7, 0xb841dbcb8af4fae4775549882a7ebdd6cdc29705, 0x2071d1689d85de2b49004d257f99802a25bf4fe7, 0x6643d74db59411215faa16cea48c9fb94dbd89c7). One BeaconUpgraded proxy-upgrade event (block 25376611, 2026-06-23) is shown. The address args are derived from the ABI-encoded constructor data.

Docs index. Includes pages for blockchain addresses, smart contract integration, price oracle, transparency dashboard, mint/redeem for SIERRA and SPLUS. No dedicated governance or bug bounty page is listed.
Fetch returned 'Page Not Found'. The older URL returned by search has been removed and replaced by /building-with-sierra/blockchain-addresses.

protocol_metadata.about: Sierra Protocol issues yield-bearing vault tokens (SIERRA, SPLUS) that users mint with stablecoins, with reserves deployed into real-world-asset and DeFi yield sources such as OpenTrade vaults. Vault tokens can be upgraded to Liquid Vault Tokens that are bridged cross-chain via LayerZero OFT and priced with a RedStone NAV oracle. The contracts are built on OpenTrade's LYT pool framework and use beacon proxies with compliance controls such as pausing and freezing.
